text: na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi . vedanā aniccā . saññā . saṅkhārā . viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi .
